feedback: You correctly accessed both fruit.name and fruit.color properties within the map callback. However, the syntax `{fruit.name, fruit.color}` uses the comma operator which only displays the last value (fruit.color). To display both properties, you need to format them properly, such as `{fruit.name} - {fruit.color}` or `{fruit.name + ' - ' + fruit.color}`.
hint: Use string concatenation or template literals to combine both properties for display.
